observation.text:
What we do (and what it costs)
Service
What you get
Price (USD)
Silent Move-Out
You leave for the afternoon. We pack everything and
move it to your new place, and it's done in under 4
hours. Up to 3 movers, a van and all the boxes and tape
are included, plus a photo report at the end. One
drop-off address, anywhere we cover.
Studio or 1-bedroom: $150
2 bedrooms: $220
3+ bedrooms: $300
The Swap
One of our couriers takes your things to your ex and
brings theirs back. You both approve a photo checklist
first, and we photograph every item at pickup and again
at drop-off. Only happens if both of you agree to it.
$40 a trip in Beirut
$55 a trip to Metn
Memory Vault
For the stuff you can't throw out yet but can't look at
either. We keep it in a sealed box (60 x 40 x 40 cm) for
3, 6 or 12 months. Two weeks before the end we'll
message you, and you decide: take it back, send it to
your ex (only if they want it), or donate it through one of
our partner charities.
$15 a month per box (3
months minimum)
12 months: $150 per box

Service
What you get
Price (USD)
Fresh Start
A deep clean, the furniture moved around and three new
plants, so the place stops feeling like "ours". Takes
about 5 hours.
Studio or 1-bedroom: $120
2+ bedrooms: $170
The Full Clean
Break
A Silent Move-Out (studio or 1-bedroom), one Swap and
3 months of Memory Vault for one box.
$210 (you save $25)

The people
Name
What they do

most of the worrying.
Mohamad Hamdan

the end.
Zakaria El Labban
Co-founder, Head of Customer Care. Came from event planning. Wrote most of
